threat_event: Nation-state actor steals CUI from the shared GCEE using stolen sessions or tokens
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One environment holds two divisions and many programs; adversary-in-the-middle phishing defeats push MFA; one download threshold for all projects
existing_controls: MFA; 24x7 SOC; export tags; project-based access
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all GCEE users; per-project download baselines (Program H first); token binding and session revocation playbook; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from plant OT or the Plant 9 legacy network to several plants and halts production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 9 legacy network; unsupported controllers; USB loading at 3 plants; MES logs missing at 4 plants
existing_controls: Plant firewalls; EDR on servers; nightly MES backups for plants 1 to 8
treatment_plan: Keep Plant 9 isolated until migration; device control at all USB transfer stations; MES and DNC logs to the SIEM at all plants; quarterly MES restore tests

threat_event: A GCEE outage or integrity failure idles engineering in two divisions or releases a wrong revision to plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One PLM environment for two divisions and 9 plants; revision check after restore is manual
existing_controls: Paired-region failover; restore tests twice a year; release checksums
treatment_plan: Automate the post-restore revision check against PLM release records; add a plant-side checksum verification
owner: Group data and engineering platforms director

threat_event: The group cannot show CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO) status when Phase 2 solicitations require it, and loses or delays awards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enterprise CUI Environment score 79; requirements that cannot be on a POA&M still open; ES systems joined late
affected_asset_or_process: Enterprise CUI Environment; about $6 billion of annual defense revenue
existing_controls: CMMC program office; 2024 DIBCAC High Assessment (98)
treatment_plan: Close every 5-point and non-POA&M-eligible requirement by 2026-11-30; C3PAO assessment 2026-12-07; carve the HPC cluster out of scope if not ready

threat_event: Sister-division CSP (SYS-D4) holds CUI without FedRAMP Moderate equivalency, putting 14 customers and Aircraft Parts out of compliance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Industry edition built on an authorized platform but not authorized itself; 23 open 3PAO findings; marketed as "FedRAMP-ready"
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D4; Aircraft Parts tenant; 13 external contractor tenants
existing_controls: 3PAO assessment; SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Close the 23 findings; pursue FedRAMP Moderate authorization; tell CUI tenants the current status in writing; Aircraft Parts moves its CUI to the GCEE in the meantime

threat_event: A supplier receiving CUI is breached or cannot show the CMMC status a Phase 2 subcontract needs
threat_source: Cybercriminals and nation-state actors targeting suppliers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,450 suppliers receive CUI; CMMC status verified for 38% of those needing Level 2 (C3PAO)
existing_controls: Flowdown clause library; gateway per-partner folders
treatment_plan: Verify SPRS and CMMC status for every CUI supplier before release; reduce CUI sent to outside processors; supplier notice clause in purchase orders

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses a DoD, customer, export, or SEC deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Matrix not exercised; Defense Software has no medium assurance certificate holder; each division files under its own contracts
existing_controls: Group IR plan; 6 certificate holders in two divisions; disclosure committee
treatment_plan: Adopt the group notification matrix (P08); 2 certificate holders in Defense Software; cross-division tabletop by 2026-11-18

threat_event: An insider takes CUI or export-controlled data before leaving for a competitor or foreign employer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large engineering population; bulk download possible within project rights; thick workstations allow registered drives
existing_controls: Entity-wide insider threat program; HR-driven termination; device control
treatment_plan: Departure-risk watchlist feed to the SOC; download alerts for notice-period staff; drive use reviewed weekly for flagged users

threat_event: ITAR or EAR technical data is released to a foreign person without authorization
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper visitor logs at Plant 9; partner shares not tagged by agreement; engineers on allied programs
existing_controls: Export compliance office; U.S.-person gating; Empowered Officials
treatment_plan: Electronic visitor system at Plant 9; agreement tags on partner shares; quarterly export audit of GCEE shares

threat_event: CUI or export-controlled data is pasted into public AI services or exposed by an AI assistant with broad access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public chatbot use observed at two Engineering Services centers; assistant pilot inherits broad file permissions; standard adopted only 2026-06
existing_controls: Web category blocks on GCEE; Group AI Standard; approved-tools list
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): blocks on all CUI endpoints, assistant permission clean-up, logging, training

threat_event: An acquired site joins the business before it meets group controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant 9 kept its own network and file server; no pre-close cyber due diligence standard
existing_controls: Integration program office
treatment_plan: Cyber due diligence and day-1 isolation standard for acquisitions; Plant 9 migration

threat_event: Program H cannot obtain Level 3 (DIBCAC) status when Phase 3 begins
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Level 3 needs Final Level 2 (C3PAO) for its scope first; supply chain risk plan and Specialized Asset security not in place
affected_asset_or_process: Program H enclave; Program H production cell
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; incident response team; Program H enclave
treatment_plan: Level 3 readiness plan: threat hunting, supply chain risk plan, Specialized Asset security for the Program H cell, security solution rationale in the SSP

threat_event: Division supplements weaken group policy without anyone noticing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineering Services supplement last aligned 2024; conflicts on removable media and cloud storage
existing_controls: Annual policy review
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Engineering Services supplement; annual alignment attestation for all three divisions

threat_event: Undocumented inheritance makes common controls look missing in the C3PAO assessment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HPC cluster and test systems joined the CUI environment without inheritance documentation
affected_asset_or_process: Engineering Services systems; common control catalog
existing_controls: Common control catalog; Aircraft Parts inheritance matrix
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix for the HPC cluster and test systems; include in SSP annex
owner: Engineering Services security and compliance lead

threat_event: A provider A government-community region outage stops the GCEE and both platform editions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All CUI workloads in one provider; paired-region failover tested only for the GCEE
existing_controls: Paired-region failover; warm standby for SYS-D3 and SYS-D4
treatment_plan: Annual paired-region failover test for SYS-D3 and SYS-D4

threat_event: Malicious code inserted through the software factory reaches the DoD edition
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Build pipeline secrets; third-party dependencies
existing_controls: Signed builds; dependency scanning; PAM for pipeline admins
treatment_plan: Build provenance attestations; isolated build runners for the DoD edition

threat_event: The group discloses a material cybersecurity incident late or inaccurately
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality depends on facts from three divisions and many customers
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter includes cybersecurity materiality
treatment_plan: Materiality factor sheet for DIB incidents in the P08 runbook

threat_event: Government-related data from the DoD edition is used for another purpose without Contracting Officer approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model retraining in 2026-05 combined DoD edition telemetry with industry edition data; no data-use gate
existing_controls: Release board
treatment_plan: Stop the reuse; delete derived features; data-use gate in the release process; disclose to the Contracting Officers as counsel advises

threat_event: The government-community identity tenant is compromised and used to reach every CUI system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single tenant for all CUI systems; global administrator roles
existing_controls: Hardware keys for admins; PAM; SOC monitoring of admin actions
treatment_plan: Break-glass review; tenant-level anomaly detection; quarterly admin role attestation

threat_event: A shortage of qualified staff and assessor capacity delays remediation and the C3PAO window
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several divisions compete for the same CMMC specialists; one contracted C3PAO window
existing_controls: CMMC program office staffing plan
treatment_plan: Reserve a backup C3PAO window in 2027-01; cross-train division security leads

threat_event: Classified information spills onto unclassified systems at a cleared center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Classified and unclassified work at the same centers
affected_asset_or_process: Engineering Services cleared centers; HPC cluster
existing_controls: Facility security officers; separate classified systems
treatment_plan: Spillage drill for the HPC team; spillage step in P08
